Name: Food page: daily Fat macro label is visible
Description: Checks the day-level Fat macro label is visible in the nutrient summary.

Name: Food page: Logs section header is visible
Description: Checks the Logs section header is visible on the Food page.

Name: Food page: View Details link is visible
Description: Checks the View Details link next to the nutrient summary is visible.

Name: Food page: Consumed value is a real, non-negative number
Description: Checks the Consumed calorie value in the header nutrient summary is a valid non-negative number.

Name: Food page: daily Carbs macro label is visible
Description: Checks the day-level Carbs macro label is visible in the nutrient summary.

Name: Food page: View Logs link is visible
Description: Checks the View Logs link is visible next to the Logs section header.

Name: Food page: daily Protein macro label is visible
Description: Checks the day-level Protein macro label is visible in the nutrient summary.

Name: Food page: Set Targets button is visible
Description: Checks the Set Targets button is visible on the Food page.

Name: Food page: Goal value is a real, positive number
Description: Checks the Goal calorie value in the header nutrient summary is a valid positive number.

Name: Food page: kcal status text is visible on the summary gauge
Description: Checks the 'kcal left' or 'kcal over' status label is visible on the circular nutrient summary gauge, depending on whether Consumed is under or over the Goal.

Name: Food page: Fiber sub-nutrient label is visible
Description: Checks the Fiber sub-nutrient card label is visible on the Food page.
